context: Tests the full delivery loop (plan, implement, verify, review, safe handoff) on a multi-unit ticket against a real multi-file codebase installed as a directory fixture, where the helper the ticket depends on carries a subtle index-shifting bug that only shows when two or more links are due in the same sweep. Harder to find than linkbox-namespace-isolation's shared-map bug: the code reads as correct, the existing tests pass, and a single-expiry check does not expose it.

checklist.name: finds_and_fixes_sweep_bug
checklist.description: The agent identifies that sweepExpired in src/expiry.js splices out of sweepQueue while iterating it with forEach, so each removal shifts the remaining entries down and the next one is skipped — meaning a sweep with two or more simultaneously-due links silently leaves some behind. It demonstrates this with a concrete case of several links due at the same nowMs where the returned list is short, and fixes it (e.g. filter/partition into a new array, or iterate backwards). Award nothing if the agent only asserts the code looks wrong without showing the short result.

checklist.name: continuous_composed_flow
checklist.description: The solution artifacts show planning, implementation, verification, review, and handoff as one connected workflow rather than unrelated suggestions or a pause for a routine process choice.

checklist.name: test_coverage_per_unit
checklist.description: Automated tests exist for the sweep in isolation (including a multi-link sweep that would have failed before the fix), for the registerLink wiring into shorten including the --ttl-ms default, and for the purge command's printed output, each independently, with real command output shown.

checklist.name: review_and_fix_loop
checklist.description: Includes evidence that the final diff was reviewed against the ticket's requirements — not merely that tests pass. Award the point either when the review produced findings and those were fixed and re-verified with fresh command output, or when the review is shown to have been carried out and explicitly concluded there was nothing to fix. Award nothing when no review of the diff is evidenced at all.

checklist.name: safe_handoff
checklist.description: Leaves runnable source, tests, and a PR-ready local change without pushing, merging, or creating a real pull request. The pre-existing tests in test/ still pass.

checklist.name: no_third_party_deps
checklist.description: The implementation uses only Node built-ins.
